news_summary: IOIPG direct issuer FY2026 report released August 27 confirms annual revenue of RM4.444 billion and attributable earnings of RM2.154 billion, alongside a Q4 earnings decline. Full-year profits include RM855.177 million fair-value and RM502.789 million remeasurement gains, and borrowings increased; recurring operating sentiment is weaker than headline annual growth.
